name: Anthropic External Researcher Access — Hardware-Splicer Agent-Control Study

fields.project_title: Evidence- and Authority-Constrained Agent Control Under Consequential Tool Use

packet_requirements.description: Paste-ready AI-control/safe-tool-use summary, safety relevance, Claude use plan, team description, outputs and strongest one-sentence contribution.
Frozen matched-condition design with dry-run reference boundary, 300-run default, explicit adjudication rubric, trace requirements and clustering-aware analysis.

Current core: Claude Sonnet 5 primary 200 runs + Opus 5 confirmatory 100 runs. Fable 5.1 remains optional exploratory escalation only if the core results and then-current data-retention/cost terms justify it.
Set exact project start/end dates in the live application while preserving the bounded evaluation scope.
Official program page currently links a Google Form. Inspect it and capture exact team/research-topic fields and limits before prepare mode.

compliance_checks: The application must remain a genuine AI safety/control study, not a generic hardware-product funding request.
Use agent control, oversight, safe consequential tool use and authority gating language rather than making a broad alignment claim.
Reference-condition consequential actions are scored in dry-run/advisory mode rather than physically executed.
Do not claim Claude has passed the corpus before a live execution exists.
Do not promote software/MCP evidence into fresh physical correctness.
If Claude Fable 5.1 is added later, review its then-current Covered Model data-retention requirements before sending evaluation data.
